description: Health of x402 payment facilitators from Factline's hourly probes (no money moves): current status (up/down/unknown), 7-day uptime, latency, networks supported. Omit "facilitator" to list all tracked facilitators (about a dozen); pass an id (e.g. "cdp", "payai"), name, or facilitator URL to look one up. A facilitator that is not in the feed returns found:false with the tracked ids; absence is NOT evidence of health. Every response carries source, data_as_of (latest probe time) and warnings (stale or empty feed).

facilitator.description: Optional facilitator id (cdp, payai, dexter...), name, or URL. Omit to list all.
